description: Prescribed Burning on the Old Woman Plateau is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFWS, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service. A recent history of less frequent fire on the OWP has led to an increase in heavy fuels. These heavy fuels, paired with increased climate variability and longer periods of hotter, drier weather, can cause larger and more severe fires in both fire-adapted and non-fire-adapted ecosystems. Coverage: Old Woman Plateau (2024). The toolkit gives Old Woman Plateau as the location, 2024 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
